tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Hybris & E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, OCC APIs, Backoffice, catalog, pricing, promotions, and OMS. Experienced with PIM, ERP, and MDM integrations, agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, code reviews, and international technical teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Hybris Functional Expert
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the Senior Hybris Functional Expert role at Capgemini to help shape exceptional digital customer experiences. With over five years of professional experience as a backend and e-commerce developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in designing, extending, and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Core Modules & Extensions
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including Promotions Engine, Hotfolders, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Order Management (OMS).

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, and integrated external services through the SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked successfully within agile and distributed international teams using Jira and Confluence, participating in code reviews and supporting production troubleshooting.

cover_en.gap: While my professional background is rooted in backend development and technical implementation rather than formal business analysis or requirements workshops, I am very keen to learn and bridge business needs with scalable e-commerce solutions.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and my earliest start date on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Capgemini because of its inspiring global digital customer experience team, its dedication to sustainable and inclusive technological solutions, and the opportunity to collaborate with inspiring colleagues across industries.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to Capgemini's DCX team to build scalable, high-impact e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I applied for the Senior Hybris Functional Expert position. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, plus valid German work authorization, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your DCX team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Hybris Functional Expert - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my cover letter and CV, for the Senior Hybris Functional Expert position at Capgemini.

With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) across enterprise projects for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in core modules, OCC APIs, and agile teamwork. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available starting 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
